subject.title: fix(ci): script-only changes cold-start every Node job

question: Is protected-lane post-merge verification of the first v2 writer and following warm consumer acceptable for this cache-contract change, or is a trusted pre-merge staging run required before landing?
rationale: The branch has credible cold-transition and guard-test evidence, but the protected snapshot is intentionally not writable from PR jobs, so code review cannot establish the decisive warm-hit without an owner-controlled environment.

options.title: Approve guarded staged rollout
options.body: Accept the PR's trusted post-merge writer/consumer verification plan, require redacted logs for both events, and revert if either fails.

options.title: Require protected staging evidence
options.body: Run the reviewed head through an owner-controlled protected-snapshot staging path before merging, then attach the warm-hit evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded staged rollout
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's trusted post-merge writer/consumer verification plan, require redacted logs for both events, and revert if either fails.
